summary: AGM Group Holdings filed a Form 6-K (Hong Kong/BVI foreign private issuer, US-equivalent 8-K) on October 15, 2026, attaching notice and proxy for a special extraordinary meeting on October 28, 2026. The sole resolution seeks approval to repurchase 1,200,000 Class B ordinary shares from CEO/director Zhu Bo at approximately US$6.67 per share, for an aggregate US$8,000,000 cash. Repurchased shares will be cancelled but remain available for re-issuance. The board and a specially formed independent-director committee recommended the transaction as fair and beneficial to remaining shareholders, pricing set via arm's-length negotiation. Watch for minority-shareholder dilution/related-party optics and post-cancellation Class B voting-control shifts.
